targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_amd_uprof_status") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "exit_code" or r._field == "events_total") |> last()

panels.title: AMD uProf Collector Status
panels.description: AMD uProf collector availability and exit state. Non-zero exit_code usually means unavailable or failed collection; check logs for the exact cause.

targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_amd_uprof_pcm") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.tool == "amd-uprof-pcm") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frequency_ghz" or r._field == "ipc" or r._field == "cpi") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: CPU Frequency / IPC
panels.description: Primary AMDuProfPcm CPU samples only. Sidecar collectors can emit overlapping CPU fields and are kept out of this panel.

targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_amd_uprof_pcm") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "memory_read_gbs" or r._field == "memory_write_gbs") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Memory Bandwidth
panels.description: Memory bandwidth appears only when the installed AMDuProfPcm/platform supports memory metrics. Some Ryzen/mobile systems report this metric as unsupported.

targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_amd_uprof_pcm") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "package_watts" or r._field == "core_watts") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Power appears only when AMDuProfPcm emits package/core watt fields. On some AMD systems this requires amd_hsmp or hsmp_acpi support on the host.

targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_amd_uprof_status") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "events_total" or r._field == "numeric_fields_total") |> last()

panels.title: AMD uProf Parsed Fields
panels.description: How much AMD uProf output was parsed into bounded metrics. Low values usually mean the raw CSV/log needs parser tuning.
